newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares extend bull run despite corrections.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares extend bull run despite corrections.

text.p: Egyptian shares extended a bull run into the 21st day on Tuesday despite some correction in the prices of what one broker called the overheated stocks.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index rose about half a percent to 421.12 points in turnover worth a very high 302 million pounds ($88.8 million).

The biggest component was the long delayed privatisation sale of 75 percent of al-Ahram Beverages to the U.S.-based Luxor Group. The state sold 3.3735 million shares at 68.50 pounds a share, the price agreed months ago.
Back in the real market, banks performed well on expectations that they can take quick advantage of economic expansion but the milling and cement sectors saw some declines.
Commercial International Bank (CIB) gained 38.98 pounds to close at a one-year high of 804.03 and Misr International Bank also hit a one-year record -- up 38.98 at 818.77 pounds.

But Amriyah Cement, Helwan Portland Cement and Suez Cement lost ground on perceptions that they would not increase production capacity in the near term, brokers said. Amriyah Cement, one of the 10 most active stocks, closed 2.50 pounds down at 78 pounds.

"Strong cement companies with potential for growth are not doing badly, but not so much the others," said Sherif Cararah of brokers EFG-Hermes. "There was also some correction on the overheated stocks, such as the milling sector."
All the milling shares fell, with the sole exception of Central and West Delta Flour Mills, which rose 4.40 to end the day at 130.00 pounds.

Medinet Nasr Housing and Development, the third most active share, gained 16.50 to close at 502.50. "It wasn't well known before that shareholders could get their free share by holding shares at the end of March," Cararah said.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 724.49 points from 717.41 on Monday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 271.56 from 271.33 points.
Out of the 85 shares traded, 45 gained, 16 lost and 24 ended the day unchanged.
